answer: A diversity threshold stops sybils. An identity qualifies after trades with eight partners from four clusters, including a juniper grower outside its graph. A reef route is a second cluster, and a falcon courier counts from a third; each partner endorses one newcomer per epoch. The kth fake needs a kth set at 5 credits each, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 40 once. Rented pools fail: shared funding adds zero trades.
